name: Café Latte
caffeineNote: Raposa's product page states 150 mg of caffeine
summary: Raposa's nitro cold brew with oat milk, from the brand's own site and not yet checked against a can: 150 mg of caffeine and 40 calories in a 250 mL (8.45 oz) can, sweetened with erythritol and sucralose rather than sugar. Raposa lists cold brew at 62.45% of the can and oat beverage at 35.4%, plus inulin; it publishes no sugar or protein figures.
